title.narrative: Mapping of the Catholic Church' s socio-environmental initiatives in the Brazilian Amazon region

description.narrative: The purpose of this project is to produce a socio-environmental analysis to guide specific activities to defend human rights and protect the common good, as set out in the encyclical, “Laudato Sí”, within Catholic dioceses, parishes and social pastoral groups and communities in the Amazon region of Brazil. This project will work with the Brazilian Bishop’s Conference (CNBB) National committee of the Pan-Amazonian Church Network to collect and disseminate information on the Catholic church’s social initiatives and challenges of protecting the Amazon environment. Research will be conducted at parish and diocesan level and also in collaboration with other secular bodies in the states that make up the Amazon region of Brazil. The final mapping, which will be made available in hard copies and electronic versions, will help inform and improve the Catholic Church’s strategy and action in areas where it is already engaged and, where this is not the case, it will help strengthen and guide a more strategic intervention for its social pastoral work.
